assumptions: the holder triple at +0x00/+0x08/+0x10 is a begin/end/capacity-end triple for the same 0x70-stride record array; the routine reads begin and end at entry and capacity end only at exit

a record's three vectors are begin/end/capacity-end triples at +0x08/+0x10/+0x18, +0x38/+0x40/+0x48 and +0x50/+0x58/+0x60; the routine reads each triple's begin and end for its walk and its capacity end for its span free

a vector element is a string whose data pointer at +0x00 and capacity at +0x10 follow the short-form rule: data pointer equal to the element's own +0x10 slot address means short form and frees nothing, otherwise the sized delete frees capacity + 1 bytes

consumers.argument_setup_pattern: at the sole site rdi is loaded from rbx immediately before the call (mov %rbx,%rdi at 0x5d7d726); the fragment's register provenance for rbx beyond that load is not pinned
consumers.caller_note: the caller frame is a cleanup fragment: its code calls __cxa_begin_catch, __cxa_end_catch and __cxa_rethrow nearby, and the fragment is entered by a tail jump from the personality stub at 0x5d7dd4d in FDE 0x5d7d740..0x5d7dd9a; the owning function's identity beyond that fragment is not pinned

exit.empty_vector: begin equal to end skips the record loop; the exit then frees the holder span only when the holder begin is non-null
exit.holder_span: span = [holder+0x10] - [holder+0x00], freed by a tail jump to the sized-delete PLT at 0x63f0d80
exit.null_begin: a null holder begin returns plainly with nothing freed

outer_loop.end_source: end is [holder+0x08], read once at entry into r12
outer_loop.exit_condition: the loop ends when the record cursor equals the end pointer

per_vector.buffer_span: after the element walk, the vector buffer is freed as one span (capacity end minus begin) when the begin pointer is non-null; a null begin frees nothing for that vector
per_vector.element_walk: elements are visited from begin to end in order; per element, the data pointer at +0x00 is compared against the element's own +0x10 slot address; on equality (short form) the element is skipped, otherwise the sized delete at PLT 0x63f0d80 frees capacity + 1 bytes where capacity is the element's +0x10 field
per_vector.unread_fields: record bytes at +0x00..+0x08, +0x20..+0x38 and +0x68..+0x70 are never read by this routine; their roles are not claimed

arguments.rdi: holder pointer: vector triple (begin +0x00, end +0x08, capacity end +0x10)

routine.prologue: endbr64, pushes r14, r13, r12, rbp, rbx, no stack reserve, no canary check
routine.result: no return value; the routine destroys the holder's records and frees the holder buffer span

unknowns: the owning function behind the cleanup fragment that holds the sole call site
roles of record bytes at +0x00..+0x08, +0x20..+0x38 and +0x68..+0x70
